description: This file defines internal logging event IDs for the MigraDoc.DocumentObjectModel component, using Microsoft's logging abstractions. It declares constants and static EventId objects for various log events related to fonts and internal operations.

classes.name: AppLogEventIds
classes.description: Contains constant integer identifiers for specific logging events within the MigraDoc Document Object Model internals.

classes.name: AppLogEvents
classes.description: Provides static EventId instances associated with the internal logging events, utilizing the identifiers from AppLogEventIds.

methods.name: AppLogEvents.MDDOM
methods.description: Represents the EventId for MDDOM logs, initialized with the identifier from AppLogEventIds and label 'NDDOM'.

methods.name: AppLogEvents.FontNotFound
methods.description: EventId for font not found events.

methods.name: AppLogEvents.Create
methods.description: EventId for creation events, included only in DEBUG mode.

methods.name: AppLogEvents.Read
methods.description: EventId for read events, included only in DEBUG mode.

methods.name: AppLogEvents.Update
methods.description: EventId for update events, included only in DEBUG mode.

methods.name: AppLogEvents.Delete
methods.description: EventId for delete events, included only in DEBUG mode.

methods.name: AppLogEvents.ReadNotFound
methods.description: EventId for read not found events, included only in DEBUG mode.

methods.name: AppLogEvents.UpdateNotFound
methods.description: EventId for update not found events, included only in DEBUG mode.
